title: Fleet Manager / Superintendent of Facilities interview guide - 2017
summary: Historical structured interview guide for Fleet Manager and Superintendent of Facilities, including minimum qualifications, maintenance/supervisory/job-duty questions, policy explanation prompts, accommodation inquiry and interviewer recommendation.

claims.claim: The form treated a high-school diploma/GED, CDL with passenger endorsement or ability to obtain it within 30 days, and vehicle/building maintenance experience as minimum-requirement topics.

evidence.note: Historical interview guide; current qualification requirements require newer evidence.

claims.claim: The interviewer was instructed to review the application/resume and explain wages, benefits and key policies including attendance, dress code, drug/alcohol policy and codes of conduct.
The form asks whether the candidate can perform job duties and whether accommodations are needed.

trigger: Interview scheduled for Fleet Manager / Superintendent of Facilities candidate.
prerequisites: Application and/or resume available for interviewer review.
actors: Executive Director for possible further interview
steps: Ask structured experience and job-duty questions.
Review application/resume for additional relevant points.
Discuss ability to perform job duties and accommodations.
Explain wages, benefits and named policies.
Sign and date the interview form.
decisions: Recommend applicant for the position, reject, or refer for further interview with Executive Director.
deadlines: Historical form states CDL/passenger endorsement could be obtained within 30 days of employment.
controls: Structured prompts intended to cover minimum requirements and core duties.
unresolved_questions: Is this interview form still used for the position?
What current job description/qualification standard supersedes the 2017 requirements?
Which interview observations remain appropriate under current hiring practices and EEO guidance?
automation_candidates: Versioned structured interview checklist tied to the current job description.
Require interviewer completion/sign-off before applicant status can advance.
Automatically surface only current approved interview questions and qualification criteria.

provenance.notes: Blank interview guide, not applicant-specific record.
